payload.ranking: 1. U1 QR-ENCODER FEASIBILITY (R3, ADR-1) - can we OBTAIN a correct, scannable, vendorable QR encoder (byte mode + Reed-Solomon ECC), with no external call? What-if-wrong: if no library is already present or fetchable in this fenced/offline environment, the VENDOR path (K2) is not executable and we fall back to hand-roll (K1) or the owner provides the source. HIGHEST - it decides the whole build path. This is the vendor-vs-hand-roll tripwire from M5, now a live question.
payload.seeded: - SP1 (U1), timebox 30 min: probe availability - is a QR encoder already present (node_modules / tools/vendor / the repo), fetchable via npm, or must it be hand-rolled? Then confirm the chosen encoder turns a known input into the correct QR matrix (known-answer / decode check). The result picks K2 (vendor, if a source is obtainable) or K1 (hand-roll, the recorded fallback).
